author: Li, Xinpin
summary: The wounds caused by family members—the negative imprints left by our family of origin—heal too slowly, are too hard to forget, and forgiveness often feels out of reach. Once these scars are etched into our body and mind, they leave us burdened with mistrust, self-doubt, guilt, shame, fear, anger, hatred, neediness, and helplessness—patterns that continue to generate problems and lead us to repeat the same painful cycles. The only way out is through a three-step rapid scan to uncover the core "Trojan horse" imprints passed down through generations. By identifying and courageously discarding what no longer serves us, we can break free from the negative scripts of family destiny. This awakening allows us to transform our emotional scars into fuel for rebirth and personal growth. From there, we apply a higher-dimensional decoding method—the Ultimate Life Formula (RAM)—to escape the matrix of inherited life patterns. This process restores our original inner settings, reconnects us to a pure and untainted seed consciousness, and empowers us to live with true freedom, creating an expansive and limitless life of our own design

title: Earthfall
author: Walden, Mark.
summary: Sam wakes to see strange vessels gathered in the skies around London. As he stares up, people stream past, walking silently towards the enormous ships which emit a persistent noise. Only Sam seems immune to the signal. Six months later, Sam is absolutely alone. In his underground bunker he has food and water for a couple of days. He has no choice but to venture above. Spotted by a flying drone, Sam escapes, but not before the drone slashes him with a barbed tendril. That night, drenched in sweat, Sam realises without medical supplies the wound will kill him. This time above ground he is less lucky. Cornered again, Sam thinks he has reached the end - then the drone is shot down in a hail of machine gun fire. In five minutes Sam learns two things: he is not alone; the drone injury should have killed him instantly - yet he is still alive. The battle for earth is about to begin.
